title: Watershed Development
description: Restoring water security in drought-prone Rayalaseema through hydrological planning, community-led construction, and natural-resource governance.
features: 142+ check dams and 87 farm ponds built
Treatment of over 22,000 acres of degraded land
Rock-fill dams, percolation tanks, gully plugs

title: Sustainable Agriculture & FPOs
description: Mobilizing smallholders into Farmer Producer Organizations and championing climate-resilient cropping, millets revival and direct market linkages.

title: Women's Empowerment
description: Federating women into Self-Help Groups, linking them with savings & credit, livelihoods training and leadership roles in village institutions.

title: Child Rights & Education
description: Working with Childline, schools and police to prevent trafficking, end child labour and ensure every child stays in school.

title: Health & Nutrition
description: Improving maternal and child health through nutrition awareness, health camps, and access to government health services.
